library(dplyr)
library(recipes)

``` {r}
# Function to preprocess data without causing leakage
preprocess_data <- function(df, target_col, recipe_obj = NULL, is_training = TRUE) {
  df <- df %>% mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor))

  if (is_training) {
    recipe_obj <- recipe(as.formula(paste(target_col, "~ .")), data = df) %>%
      step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
      step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
      step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = TRUE) %>%
      prep(training = df) # Prepare using training data only
  }

  processed_df <- bake(recipe_obj, new_data = df) # Apply transformations
  target <- processed_df[[target_col]]
  predictors <- processed_df %>% select(-all_of(target_col))

  list(x = as.matrix(predictors), y = as.numeric(target), recipe_obj = recipe_obj)
}


initialize_parameters <- function(input_size, hidden_size1, hidden_size2, output_size = 1) {
  if (is.na(input_size) || is.na(hidden_size1) || is.na(hidden_size2) || is.na(output_size)) {
    stop("Invalid dimensions passed to initialize_parameters.")
  }
  list(
    W1 = matrix(runif(input_size * hidden_size1, -0.5, 0.5), nrow = input_size, ncol = hidden_size1),
    b1 = runif(hidden_size1, -0.5, 0.5),
    W2 = matrix(runif(hidden_size1 * hidden_size2, -0.5, 0.5), nrow = hidden_size1, ncol = hidden_size2),
    b2 = runif(hidden_size2, -0.5, 0.5),
    W3 = matrix(runif(hidden_size2 * output_size, -0.5, 0.5), nrow = hidden_size2, ncol = output_size),
    b3 = runif(output_size, -0.5, 0.5)
  )
}

leaky_relu <- function(x, alpha = 0.01) {
  pmax(alpha * x, x)
}

# Batch normalization function
batch_normalize <- function(x) {
  mean_x <- colMeans(x)
  std_x <- apply(x, 2, sd)
  (x - mean_x) / (std_x + 1e-8) # Normalize with small epsilon to avoid division by zero
}

forward_propagation <- function(x, params) {
  # First hidden layer
  z1 <- x %*% params$W1 + matrix(params$b1, nrow = nrow(x), ncol = length(params$b1), byrow = TRUE) # nolint: line_length_linter. # nolint
  a1 <- leaky_relu(z1)
  # nolint
  # Second hidden layer
  z2 <- a1 %*% params$W2 + matrix(params$b2, nrow = nrow(a1), ncol = length(params$b2), byrow = TRUE)
  a2 <- leaky_relu(z2)

  # Output layer
  z3 <- a2 %*% params$W3 + matrix(params$b3, nrow = nrow(a2), ncol = length(params$b3), byrow = TRUE)

  list(a1 = a1, a2 = a2, z3 = z3)
}

# Mean squared error (MSE) loss function
mse_loss <- function(y_pred, y_true) {
  mean((y_pred - y_true)^2) # Compute average squared error between predictions and actual values
}

# Mean absolute error (MAE) function
mae_loss <- function(y_pred, y_true) {
  mean(abs(y_pred - y_true)) # Compute average absolute error
}

# Root mean squared error (RMSE) function
rmse_loss <- function(y_pred, y_true) {
  sqrt(mean((y_pred - y_true)^2)) # Compute RMSE
}

# R-squared (R²) Score function
r2_score <- function(y_pred, y_true) {
  ss_total <- sum((y_true - mean(y_true))^2)
  ss_residual <- sum((y_true - y_pred)^2)
  1 - (ss_residual / ss_total) # Compute R² Score
}

# Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE)
mape_loss <- function(y_pred, y_true) {
  # Add a small constant to avoid division by zero
  epsilon <- 1e-8

  # Exclude cases where y_true is too small
  valid_indices <- y_true > epsilon
  if (sum(valid_indices) == 0) {
    warning("All true values are too small for MAPE calculation.")
    return(NA)
  }

  mean(abs((y_true[valid_indices] - y_pred[valid_indices]) / (y_true[valid_indices] + epsilon))) * 100
}

train_mlp_manual <- function(df, target_col, hidden_size = 32, epochs = 5000, learning_rate = 0.02, test_split = 0.2, lambda = 0.01) {
  # Preprocess dataset
  data <- preprocess_data(df, target_col)
  x <- data$x # Extract feature matrix
  y <- data$y # Extract target variable

  # Split into training and testing sets
  set.seed(123)
  train_indices <- sample(1:nrow(x), size = floor((1 - test_split) * nrow(x)))
  train_data <- df[train_indices, ]
  test_data <- df[-train_indices, ]

  # Preprocess training data
  train_processed <- preprocess_data(train_data, target_col)
  x_train <- train_processed$x
  y_train <- train_processed$y
  recipe_obj <- train_processed$recipe_obj

  # Preprocess testing data using the same recipe
  test_processed <- preprocess_data(test_data, target_col, recipe_obj)
  x_test <- test_processed$x
  y_test <- test_processed$y

  input_size <- ncol(x_train) # Number of input features
  output_size <- 1 # Output is a single scalar (area)

  # Initialize model parameters (weights and biases)
  params <- initialize_parameters(input_size, hidden_size, hidden_size, output_size)

  final_train_loss <- NA # Initialize variable to store final training loss

  for (epoch in 1:epochs) {
    # Forward pass
    forward <- forward_propagation(x_train, params)

    y_pred_train <- forward$z3 # Predicted values for training set
    y_pred_train <- as.matrix(y_pred_train) # Ensure correct dimensions

    loss <- mse_loss(y_pred_train, y_train) # Compute training loss
    final_train_loss <- loss # Store the final training loss

    # Backward pass (compute gradients)
    dL_dz3 <- 2 * (y_pred_train - y_train) / length(y_train) # Gradient of loss w.r.t. output layer
    dL_dW3 <- t(forward$a2) %*% dL_dz3 + lambda * params$W3 # Gradient of weights in output layer
    dL_db3 <- colSums(dL_dz3) # Gradient of biases in output layer

    dL_da2 <- dL_dz3 %*% t(params$W3) # Gradient w.r.t. activations of second hidden layer
    dL_dz2 <- dL_da2 * (forward$a2 > 0) # Apply Leaky ReLU derivative
    dL_dW2 <- t(forward$a1) %*% dL_dz2 + lambda * params$W2 # Gradient of weights in second hidden layer
    dL_db2 <- colSums(dL_dz2) # Gradient of biases in second hidden layer

    dL_da1 <- dL_dz2 %*% t(params$W2) # Gradient w.r.t. activations of first hidden layer
    dL_dz1 <- dL_da1 * (forward$a1 > 0) # Apply Leaky ReLU derivative
    dL_dW1 <- t(x_train) %*% dL_dz1 + lambda * params$W1 # Gradient of weights in first hidden layer
    dL_db1 <- colSums(dL_dz1) # Gradient of biases in first hidden layer

    # Gradient descent updates
    params$W1 <- params$W1 - learning_rate * dL_dW1
    params$b1 <- params$b1 - learning_rate * dL_db1
    params$W2 <- params$W2 - learning_rate * dL_dW2
    params$b2 <- params$b2 - learning_rate * dL_db2
    params$W3 <- params$W3 - learning_rate * dL_dW3
    params$b3 <- params$b3 - learning_rate * dL_db3
  }

  list(params = params, train_loss = final_train_loss) # Return trained parameters and final training loss
}

# Cross-validation function with leakage prevention
cross_validate_mlp <- function(df, target_col, hidden_size = 32, epochs = 5000, learning_rate = 0.02, lambda = 0.01, k = 5) {
  set.seed(123) # Ensure reproducibility
  folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = nrow(df)))
  metrics <- data.frame(Fold = integer(), Train_Loss = numeric(), Test_Loss = numeric(), R2 = numeric())

  for (fold in 1:k) {
    train_data <- df[folds != fold, ]
    test_data <- df[folds == fold, ]

    # Preprocess training data only and use the same transformation for test data
    train_processed <- preprocess_data(train_data, target_col, is_training = TRUE)
    recipe_obj <- train_processed$recipe_obj
    test_processed <- preprocess_data(test_data, target_col, recipe_obj, is_training = FALSE)

    x_train <- train_processed$x
    y_train <- train_processed$y
    x_test <- test_processed$x
    y_test <- test_processed$y

    if (ncol(x_train) != ncol(x_test)) {
      stop("Feature mismatch: Training and testing sets have different numbers of features!")
    }

    # Train model on the fold
    result <- train_mlp_manual(train_data, target_col, hidden_size, epochs, learning_rate, test_split = 0.2, lambda)
    params <- result$params
    train_loss <- result$train_loss

    # Predict on test set
    y_pred_test <- forward_propagation(x_test, params)$z3

    test_loss <- mean((y_pred_test - y_test)^2)
    test_r2 <- cor(y_pred_test, y_test)^2

    metrics <- rbind(metrics, data.frame(Fold = fold, Train_Loss = train_loss, Test_Loss = test_loss, R2 = test_r2))

    print(paste("Fold", fold, "completed. Train Loss:", train_loss, "Test Loss:", test_loss, "R² Score:", test_r2))
  }

  metrics
}
```

```{r}
df <- read.csv("data/forestfires.csv") # Load dataset
df$month <- as.factor(df$month) # Convert categorical columns to factors
df$day <- as.factor(df$day)
df$area <- log1p(df$area) # Apply log(1 + x) transformation
cv_metrics <- cross_validate_mlp(df, "area", epochs = 10000, lambda = 0.05) # Perform cross-validation

print(cv_metrics) # Print cross-validation metrics
```
